prompts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: primary South Savory brand logo, isolated transparent PNG.
Input image: the supplied South Savory logo is the edit target and identity reference.
Primary request: professionally refine the existing logo into a clean, versatile primary identity. Preserve the distinctive two linked calligraphic S forms, their two small orange dots, the exact brand name South Savory, and the established year 2023. Keep the monogram very close to the original's silhouette, recognisable loops and linking diagonal. Smooth and balance the curves and improve optical spacing.
Composition: a compact centered stacked logo, mark above the wordmark. Use a single restrained thin semicircular arch framing the monogram, without scroll ends. Put small ESTD and 2023 on either side of the arch's base. Below, the exact text "South Savory" in a handsome confident serif, readable and carefully kerned, inspired by the original. Remove the long horizontal rules, terminal dots and lower ornamental flourish so the mark scales well. Give the lettering and mark generous but coherent spacing.
Palette: black #171613 for all main shapes and type, original warm orange #F36B16 for the two small dots only. No other colors.
Style: polished flat logo artwork, crisp vector-like edges, premium South Indian food brand, warm heritage character with contemporary restraint.
Constraints: ONE complete logo only, centered, large on canvas with modest clear margins. Genuine transparent background, no white rectangle, no checkerboard baked in, no mockup, no paper texture, no shadows, no gradients, no presentation labels, no tagline, no invented descriptors. Exact spelling South Savory. This should be a usable brand asset.

Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: horizontal South Savory logo on a genuinely transparent background.
Edit target/reference: supplied refined South Savory primary logo.
Create ONE wide horizontal arrangement of that same identity. Place its same distinctive linked calligraphic double-S monogram on the left, then the exact same serif wordmark "South Savory" in one line on the right. Preserve the monogram's shape and original two orange dots exactly; preserve the wordmark's serif style and spelling. Remove the arch, ESTD and year completely for this compact version. Set a generous optical gap between symbol and name. Match the symbol height to approximately 1.4 times the wordmark's capital height. This is a layout adaptation of the supplied identity, not a new design.
Palette: black #171613 with just two orange #F36B16 dots. Flat solid shapes with crisp edges. Use most of a wide canvas with comfortable margins.
No other text, no mockups, no shadows, no gradients, no background rectangle. Real transparency; do not draw a checkerboard.

Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: standalone South Savory double-S monogram, genuinely transparent PNG for stickers and profile images.
Edit target/reference: supplied refined South Savory primary logo.
Extract and faithfully recreate ONLY its distinctive linked calligraphic double-S monogram with the same TWO small orange dots in the same positions. Preserve the monogram's exact identity: paired upper tilted teardrop loops, linked rising diagonal across the middle, paired larger lower teardrop loops, thick smooth calligraphic strokes. Improve optical balance and maintain clean interior spaces. Remove all text, the semicircle arch, ESTD and year completely.
Composition: ONE centered large symbol on a square canvas, comfortably padded and fully inside the canvas, appropriate for a circular profile crop.
Palette: black #171613 for the linked S forms, orange #F36B16 for the two dots. Smooth, crisp, flat solid fills, vector-like.
Genuine transparent background, no background rectangle or circle, no simulated checkerboard, no shadows, no texture, no gradient, no additional symbols or text.

Use case: logo-brand.
Create the reversed color version of the supplied South Savory horizontal logo on a SOLID opaque dark charcoal #171613 background. Output has a completely solid background, NOT transparency.
Faithfully match the reference layout: linked calligraphic double-S symbol on left, exact same elegant serif wordmark "South Savory" on right. White #FFFFFF monogram and letters, two small solid orange #F36B16 dots. Keep all shapes smooth, fully filled and clean. Maintain the original same letterforms, proportions, space and alignment. Fill a wide canvas with the logo, with comfortable surrounding margins.
Precise flat graphic logo artwork: absolutely no distressed texture, scratches, speckling, outlines, shadows, gradients, decorative elements, or additional text. Clean solid white silhouettes against solid dark charcoal.
